description.from:
What: the end-to-end acceptance check of M7 (PPY-dad077). Creating a Prospectus deployment record for product papyrus (operator-triggered; self-serve checkout and payment come at M8) chains provisioning (PPY-70a429), the starter site, the subdomain and the owner's first Google sign-in on newsroom.p.apyr.us, with no code change, no deploy and no Cognito or certificate change.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A deployment record reaches a live site with no human step
  Given an Account entitled to a shared-tier site in staging
  When an operator creates deployment "harbour-news" through the Prospectus API
  Then harbour-news.p.apyr.us serves the starter site, the owner signs in as admin, and neither repository changed nor deployed

Scenario: A paid sign-up reaches a live site (M8 variant)
  Given a new person completes Stripe checkout in staging
  When provisioning finishes
  Then their subdomain serves a starter site and they can sign in as admin

Checks: run on staging, then on production with an internal test deployment; record timings and the git and deploy history showing no change.
